sources.entry: DashVPN - Smart-routing proxy client with support for VLESS, Shadowsocks, and HTTPS subscriptions. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dash-vpn-for-outline-vless/id6758860923?platform=mac)

summary.name: Dash VPN
summary.one_liner: Dash VPN is a smart-routing VPN/proxy client for macOS and iOS that works with Outline, VLESS, V2Ray and Sing-box servers.
use_cases: route local sites direct while proxying international sites
use Outline servers with more protocols than the official client
import HTTPS subscription links from a proxy server
block ads at the proxy level on macOS
monitor which domains are proxied, direct, or blocked
switch between global, rule, and direct proxy modes
summary.what_it_does: Dash VPN routes traffic using built-in GeoSite domain rules, sending domestic sites direct and international sites through the proxy without manual switching. It offers three modes: Rule (domain-based smart routing), Global (all traffic proxied), and Direct (all traffic bypasses the proxy). It supports Outline, VLESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan and VMess protocols, plus HTTPS subscriptions that can show data quotas and expiration info from the server. A real-time view shows which domains are proxied, direct, or blocked, and users can add custom rule sets and ad blocking.
notable: Built-in GeoSite rules for automatic domestic/international traffic split
Supports Outline, VLESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, VMess and HTTPS subscriptions
Comparison table shows more features than the Outline Official Client
Listed in awesome-mac as freeware with a Mac App Store link
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as freeware
Only macOS and iOS are named; no Windows or Linux support mentioned
